items.t: Cranks but won't start, often when hot
items.note: Hours include basic no-start testing. If the distributor igniter or coil is the cause, parts cost more.

items.job: Replace automatic transmission with remanufactured unit
items.note: A used transmission costs less. Honda's old warranty extension for these years has ended.

items.t: Airbag (SRS) light on from passenger seat sensor
items.job: Replace passenger seat-back occupant position sensor
items.note: Honda once extended coverage on this sensor; it has likely ended, but ask a dealer with your VIN.

items.job: Replace exhaust manifold (with built-in converter) and gaskets
items.note: Broken studs add time. The front catalytic converter is part of this manifold on many cars.

items.job: Replace head gasket and resurface cylinder head
items.note: Parts include gasket set, head bolts and machine shop work. Cost rises a lot if the engine was overheated badly.
Hybrid battery; rebuilt or aftermarket packs cost less than a new Honda pack.

items.job: Replace engine block (short block or complete engine)
items.note: Honda's 10-year block warranty extension has mostly ended. A used engine costs less.

items.t: Rapid or uneven rear tire wear
items.job: Replace rear upper control arms and align wheels
items.note: Hours include a four-wheel alignment. New rear tires are extra if the old ones are worn out.
Sometimes only the steering control unit or torque sensor is replaced. Ask a dealer about past extended coverage.

items.t: Knock or clunk from torn engine mount
items.note: Price is for one mount. Other mounts are often worn too.
Free under Honda's recall. Check your VIN. If the pulley is already damaged, the CVT may need replacing.

items.t: Fuel in the engine oil (oil dilution)
items.job: Update engine software and change oil
items.note: Honda covered the software update and extended warranty in cold-weather states. Ask a dealer with your VIN.

items.job: Replace A/C condenser and recharge refrigerant
items.note: Ask a Honda dealer whether goodwill or extended coverage applies to your VIN.
Free under Honda's fuel pump recall. Check your VIN first.

items.job: Inspect steering gearbox and install new worm gear spring
items.note: Free under recall 24V-744. Check your VIN. If the steering gearbox must be replaced, expect much more.
